name: DISCONTINUITY_FORENSIC_INVESTIGATION_FPS_REGRESSION_CLOSURE

fps_anomaly_investigation.finding: The ~1 FPS reported in Phase 36-R1 is NOT the actual AI processing throughput. It is an intentional throttle in the soak test script.

evidence.effect: Artificially limits frame processing loop to 1 iteration per second

actual_ai_throughput.note: GPU->CPU transfer bottleneck limits end-to-end to ~22 FPS

fps_measurement_contract.ingestion_fps: Frames entering canonical V2 ingestion (30 FPS)
fps_measurement_contract.ai_processing_fps: Frames actually processed by AI (~22 FPS NVDEC, ~17 FPS software)
fps_measurement_contract.metrics_sampling_fps: Frequency at which metrics are sampled (1 FPS in soak script)
fps_measurement_contract.critical_rule: These MUST NOT be conflated. The report must never call a 1 FPS metrics sampling rate 'AI processing FPS' unless the AI actually processes only 1 FPS.

cam2.note: CAM2 shows identical max_gap=1879 but no health state transitions recorded

analysis.gap_interpretation: 1879 frames at 1 FPS sampling = ~1879 seconds ≈ 31.3 minutes
analysis.correlation: The gap approximately equals the soak duration, suggesting the discontinuity is a metric sampling artifact, not actual frame loss
analysis.root_cause: METRIC_SAMPLING_ARTIFACT - The 1 FPS throttle causes frame_index to increment by ~1 per second in the metrics, but the actual RTSP stream delivers 30 FPS. When the health monitor transitions DEGRADED->LIVE, the frame_index tracking in the soak script misses ~1879 actual frames because it only samples 1/30th of them.
evidence: Warm-up phase had ZERO discontinuities with identical 1 FPS sampling
Health monitor shows only 5-second DEGRADED window
Phase 36D verified 30 FPS source with 0 discontinuities over 60s
analysis.classification: NOT_VERIFIED - Insufficient evidence to classify as real frame loss. The 1879-frame gap is consistent with metric sampling at 1 FPS missing 30x actual frames during a brief health state transition.

stderr_analysis.impact: ZERO - does not affect test results

phase30a_regression_closure.reasoning: All 39 tests passed with exit code 0. The PermissionError occurs during pytest's internal temp directory cleanup AFTER test execution completes. This is a known Windows/pytest issue unrelated to the enrollment database functionality.

not_found_phases_investigation.conclusion: These phases were validated through acceptance reports, not dedicated test files. The NOT_FOUND classification is correct. No fake tests should be created.

not_found: Phase 34-R Live Dual Camera E2E Revalidation
regression_test_results.overall: All executable regression tests PASS. NOT_FOUND entries correctly reflect absence of dedicated test files.

known_limitations: 1 FPS anomaly was a test script artifact (sample_interval=1.0 throttle), not a pipeline defect
Discontinuity root cause cannot be definitively proven without higher-resolution frame sampling
Phase 30A shows Windows pytest temp cleanup error (benign, post-test)
NOT_FOUND phases lack dedicated test files but have acceptance reports
Soak script metrics sampling rate (1 FPS) conflated with AI processing FPS in Phase 36-R1 report
recommendations: Remove or set sample_interval=0 in soak script for actual throughput measurement
Add explicit FPS measurement contract to prevent conflation of sampling rate vs processing rate
For future soak tests, log actual frame_index from RTSP source vs sampled frame_index
Consider adding frame-level continuity tracking at source (not just sampled)
